summary: Subject-status cache invalidation probes at most 4097 claim-index entries before reading delta bodies. An overflowing interval clears rebuildable subject caches and advances their frontier; subsequent selected reads rebuild only their requested subjects, not the fleet.

replay.detail: No persisted projection replay. Subject caches rebuild lazily from claims on demand.

rules.detail: No dependency, membership, retention or checkpoint semantics change. Overflow conservatively invalidates cached reductions.
